statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the registrar does not have access to bindings for the domain identified in the Request-URI, and if the server also acts as a proxy server, the server SHOULD forward the request to the addressed domain.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the authenticated user is not authorized to modify bindings, the registrar MUST return a 403 (Forbidden) and skip the remaining steps.
statements.trigger: user not authorized to modify bindings

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the address-of-record is not valid for the domain in the Request-URI, the registrar MUST send a 404 (Not Found) response and skip the remaining steps.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the Contact field value is '*' and the request has additional Contact fields or an expiration time other than zero, the request is invalid and the server MUST return a 400 (Invalid Request) and skip the remaining steps.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the Call-ID agrees for wildcard removal but the CSeq in the request is not higher than the value stored for that binding, the update MUST be aborted and the request fails.
statements.trigger: CSeq not higher than stored value for wildcard binding removal

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the Call-ID value in the existing binding differs from the Call-ID value in the request, the binding MUST be removed if the expiration time is zero and updated otherwise.
statements.trigger: Call-ID differs from stored binding for contact address

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the Call-IDs are the same and the CSeq value is higher than that of the existing binding, it MUST update or remove the binding as above. If not, the update MUST be aborted and the request fails.
statements.trigger: Call-ID matches stored binding for contact address; CSeq comparison
actions: update or remove binding if request.cseq > binding.cseq
abort update and fail request if request.cseq <= binding.cseq

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the requested expiration interval is greater than zero AND smaller than one hour AND less than a registrar-configured minimum, the registrar MAY reject the registration with a response of 423 (Interval Too Brief). This response MUST contain a Min-Expires header field.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The binding updates MUST be committed if and only if all binding updates and additions succeed. If any one of them fails, the request MUST fail with a 500 (Server Error) response and all tentative binding updates MUST be removed.
statements.trigger: one or more binding updates fail

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The registrar returns a 200 (OK) response. The response MUST contain Contact header field values enumerating all current bindings. Each Contact value MUST feature an 'expires' parameter. The response SHOULD include a Date header field.
actions: include Contact header with all current bindings and expires parameter per Contact

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A registrar MUST not generate 6xx responses.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Registrars MUST NOT include a Record-Route header field in any response to a REGISTER request.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: REGISTER requests MUST also be processed atomically, meaning that a particular REGISTER request is either processed completely or not at all. Each REGISTER message MUST be processed independently of any other registration or binding changes.
